content:
Website Updates

  • TTRPG website updated to be more in line with the new Clio UI.  Also changed to a darker theme, to be more easy on the eyes. (So Julio stops complaining…)

Rulebook

  • Added basic rules for Open Shop and Modded Items.
     

Races:

  • NEW:
    • Pigfolk
  • Flight now costs 0 RP instead of 0 AP and has the Rage keyword. Fixed some wording issues.

Classes:

  • NEW:
    • Still Stone Testament, a tier 3 continuation of the still stone style
    • Fusilier, a tier 2 ranged striker class.
    • Manifestor, a tier 1 stand based striker class
    • Mystic Eyes of Petrification, a tier 3 controller class
  • Aetherie
    • Making attacks through mind connection vision transfer while not using conduit now has a penalty.
  • Arcanist
    • Arcane Explosion wording updated.
  • Armiger
    • Can now store 1000u of mats per 1 slot in the armory.
    • Can now take focus and power as the level 7 stat upgrade.
  • Blacksmith
    • Forged Knowledge now has the rage keyword.
  • Bloodbinder
    • Crimson Enmity now only works during an encounter.
  • Deadeye
    • Can now be accessed through harrier.
  • Fighter
    • Charge now clarifies the attacks made with it are basic attacks.
    • Defensive Flexibility inherent circuit reset removed.
  • Forgemaster
    • Forged Knowledge II now has the rage keyword.
  • Gunslinger
    • Fan the hammer now has the Salvo keyword.
  • Peltast
    • Key ability weapon returning now also applies to class actions.
  • Martial Artist
    • Double Punch has the Dual Wield keyword.
  • Seven Sorrows Sword Style
    • One Against The World now has the blanketing keyword.
  • Spellblade
    • Elemental Strike Earth now applies Sunder instead of Slow. Holy temp HP lowered from Power + 5 to Power + 3.
  • Spell Blademaster
    • Spellblade's Preparation now specifies melee weapon.
  • Starcaller
    • Starfall now has the active keyword.
  • Summoner
    • Draw Luck now has the Rage keyword.
  • Windbringer
    • Fixed some wording issues with Fly.
  • Venomblade
    • Can now be accessed through Medic.
  • Venomancer
    • Can now be accessed through Medic.

Items

  • NEW:
    • Soaking weapon mod for vivanthal alloy.
  • Scythe full spin mow changed to be up to weapon range.
  • Twinblade haladie blade updated to specify it must be made with the twinblade.
  • Artificer crafting for weapons no longer specifies needing iron parts and can take higher quality parts.
  • Lance max dmg now lasts until end of turn instead of forever.
  • Blood and Bear Elixir can no longer stack with themselves.
  • Wolf HP increased to 25.
  • Giant Dragonfly spectral trample now also not stopped on a block.

Breakthroughs

  • Hide Behind Ally wording updated to be more clear.

Keywords

  • NEW:
    • Salvo
    • Mandate
    • Dual Wield
    • Petrify
    • Calcification
  • Isolated now counts boss enemies as 2 enemies.
